blocks.text: IBA, Zambales— A Philippine serpent eagle was rescued at Barangay Matain in Subic town, according to the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) in Central Luzon on Monday. The rescued raptor, scientifically known as Spilornis holospilus, was turned over by the Matain village government to the Community Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) in Olongapo City for proper assessment and care. CENRO Olongapo head Forester Edward Sernadilla, assisted by wildlife enforcement officer Bryan Vallejos, received the bird and conducted a preliminary health assessment.
